description: Japan bonus-stage failure and timer-expiry variant (ticket #69 / F29): identical to sf-win-02 through Geki match win and 0x40d30 entry at 9278, then replaces the 9450 HP press with a 15-frame p1_right hold at 9538 (perturbing 0xff8e4b in the random generator so 0x40fea..0x4101c gauge-zero reset and random-phase jump run when 0xff8f0e == 2 expires at 9553), lets timer 3 expire at 9721 with no punch pressed (exercising 0x41570 clr.w D2 and 0x41072..0x41078 wind-up sleeps in phase 0), and runs the failure sequence 0x41226..0x412a4 into 0x3efc4 stage_step at 10180. Continuous checkpoints 9277..=10184.

reference.notes: US set 1, six-button controls; MAME set sf. ROM set verified by mame -verifyroms against the pinned build.

machine.dipswitches: factory defaults; observed readback DSW1=0xdfff, DSW2=0xffff

inputs.comment: insert coin; title screen is up from ~1375
confirm default country Japan at country select (visible by ~1860)
perturb P1 IN1 during random_step so 0xff8e4b selects phase 0 when gauge reaches 0 at 9553
